inherited.M01: Subject-dependent models trained on each subject's own mouthed and vocalized sessions (2-3 h per subject); BAE/Delsys lineage (Meltzner 2008)
inherited.M02: Prompted text labels only; no acoustic target
inherited.M04: Silently mouthed (subvocal) speech; vocalized mode in Corpus 1
inherited.M11: Prompted transcripts from TIMIT-derived, NATO, text-message, phrase and digit sets
inherited.M13: Laboratory sessions of 4-6 h; tethered DE 2.1 and wireless Trigno Mini sensors

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table (rule unchanged): surface-EMG speech studies that evaluate a reduced subset of their electrodes or rank electrodes, classified by how the subset is chosen.
topics.metric: WER or accuracy of the best subset relative to the full array

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table (rule unchanged): sentence or phrase recognition from silently articulated speech measured by body-worn non-video sensors, classified by sentence decoder (HMM, CTC, attention, whole-sentence classification).

Surface-EMG decoders scored with WER or CER (the 64-study population of the M12 unseen-sentence table), classified by the use-time linguistic constraint their full text names: hand-written or rule grammar, n-gram language model, neural or large language model, or no language model. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); versions once; acoustic-only ASR excluded.
topics.pattern: EMG + WER/CER ledger pattern (same as M12 table)
topics.design_field: full-text regexes grammar_constrained_decoding, ngram_language_model, neural_or_llm_lm, no_language_model
topics.metric: WER on silent speech, open or closed vocabulary

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table (rule unchanged): surface-EMG decoders scored with WER or CER, classified by whether the headline error is measured on sentences absent from training.
